summary: Stable identity for a process family; owns scope, ownership, and version lineage.
Immutable published or mutable draft version of a definition.
notes: One published version max per definition.

summary: Start, step, decision, approval, handoff, wait, subprocess, or end node.
Directed edge with branch semantics, labels, and default/conditional flags.
Named responsibility role used across one definition version.
Maps a role to CRM-HR party / AI-agent profile / fallback owner metadata.
Entry/exit criteria, instructions, evidence requirements, and SLO for a step node.
notes: One contract per executable step node.

summary: Typed input/output/evidence artifact expectation for a step.
notes: Tracks direction, type, required flag, notes.

summary: Approval requirements attached to a node or transition.
Escalation targets and timeout rules for blocked or failed work.
notes: Can target party or supervisory role.

summary: Persisted diagram positions and editor UI state for one version.
Phase/lane/group representation for diagram organization.
notes: May map to group frames initially.

summary: One execution instance bound to a published process version and project context.
notes: Version reference is immutable for the run.

summary: Runtime state of one node during one run.
Current or historical claim/assignment for a runtime step.
Responsibility transfer event between runtime steps/actors.
notes: Records payload summary and completion reason.

summary: Append-only journal entry for state changes and decisions.
Links runtime steps to validation, test, prompt, file, or other artifact references.
Structured improvement proposal raised from repeated friction or KPI findings.
Persisted KPI aggregates for process versions or runs.
notes: Useful for dashboards and trend views later.

summary: Manager-governed reusable human/AI/hybrid staffing archetype with responsibility, modality, skills/capabilities, allocation intent, and governance hints.
notes: Owned by CRM-HR; referenced by Processes.

summary: Immutable approved template version used for process snapshots, sourcing history, and later improvement.
notes: Lets templates improve without rewriting prior use.

summary: Reference from a process role to the selected CRM-HR role-template/version plus captured requirement summary.
notes: Snapshotted on publish; optional only for deliberate ad-hoc exceptions.

summary: Optional pool/filter rules, capacity threshold, validation requirement, and fallback semantics used to resolve a role into an assignee or claimable pool.
notes: Bridges to CRM-HR availability and validation.

summary: Marks a required role that is unresolved, under-filled, or blocked on staffing for a definition version or live run.
Connects a process role or staffing gap to CRM-HR staffing requests, recruiting applications, or AI sourcing actions.
notes: Avoids duplicating sourcing workflow inside Processes.

summary: Owner, sponsor, customer, criticality, strategy link, stewardship, and policy tier for a process definition/version.
Upstream/downstream interface definition including sender, receiver, required inputs, outputs, done definition, and expectation metadata.
notes: May reference another process or external boundary.

summary: Declares who can decide, thresholds, evidence, and override route for a decision or approval.
notes: Can attach to node, transition, or policy gate.

summary: Completeness, classification, and quality criteria that must be satisfied before work continues.
notes: Pairs with validation and rework reasons.

summary: Approved variation from the normal path with declared trigger, owner, and control expectations.
Structured exception handling rule with escalation, override, and evidence requirements.
notes: Used by runtime when work deviates from happy path.

summary: Computed or stored runtime metrics such as lead time, touch time, queue time, rework, and SLA attainment.
Capacity, queue, wait reason, or bottleneck signal linked to process, step, or interface.
Proposed process change with reason, impact, rollout plan, and approval state.
Communication and acknowledgement records for affected stakeholders when governed changes are published.
Structured field observation or audit note linked to a process/run/version with access controls.
Repeated bypass, unofficial loop, or shadow-work pattern clustered from journals and observations.
notes: Feeds improvement backlog rather than runtime pathing directly.

summary: Typed link from definition, run, or step to project objects, work items, accounts, or other business context anchors.
notes: Supports process/project alignment without merging the two models.

summary: Normalized execution packet definition derived from step contract, actor template, interface metadata, and governance policy.
Immutable baton packet attached to a step activation or handoff, carrying the exact brief the executor received.
notes: Supports replay, supervision, and future training.

summary: Persisted decision showing how triage or dispatch selected the next role, pool, or path for a work brief.
Correlation record linking process runs and steps to external executor session, log, approval, or metric identifiers.
notes: Required for future AgentFramework adapter observability.

summary: Read-only projection describing current run state on the authored diagram, including active nodes, waits, approvals, and baton visibility.
